name: track_preparer
description: Prepares a music collection for the Volumio library in one run: unpacks archives, splits CUE+image albums, converts formats to FLAC or MP3, trims silence, embeds covers, merges multi-disc albums, sorts files into Artist/Album by tags and writes ReplayGain tags. Files are moved to a second folder, so the input is emptied as albums are finished.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: One button turns a folder of unsorted music into a clean, tagged library in a second folder: unpacks .zip, .iso and .iso.wv archives (Cyrillic names from Windows archives are restored), splits CUE+image albums (several cue files in one folder, side A/B images, images stored in parts, cue files for already split tracks), converts lossless formats to FLAC and lossy ones to MP3 VBR V0, trims silence, finds and embeds covers, merges multi-disc albums (cd1/cd2 folders and discs marked in the album name, such as Album CD2), cleans file names, sorts everything into Artist/Album by tags and writes ReplayGain 2.0 track gain. It works as a move, not a copy: finished albums are moved to the output and the input folder is emptied, together with empty folders and leftover covers/nfo, but a source file is deleted only after the converted copy is checked by size and duration. Folders with a CUE that cannot be split, or with files the plugin does not recognize, stay in place and are logged. A progress page with start and stop is served on the network.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.12.3 - category changed to music_service: miscellanea is not a category supported by the Volumio store; the plugin no longer edits /etc/mpd.conf (writing it needs root), Volumio's built-in volume normalization has to be switched off by hand in Playback Options. 1.12.2: the ReplayGain switch also commented out volume_normalization in mpd.conf while it was on. 1.12.1: fixed the ReplayGain switch not being saved when the plugin is enabled without a reboot (config now loads on demand); the preparation window follows the Volumio language. 1.12.0: ReplayGain switch moved to the top of the plugin settings; it asks Volumio's MPD plugin to add the replaygain lines (registerConfigCallback) instead of writing /etc/mpd.conf, so no root access and no template edits are needed
